metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for professional development workflows and GitHub integration

plugins.name: sdlc-core
plugins.description: Core SDLC foundations: Marvin persona output style, memory protocol, shared conventions

plugins.name: sdlc-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture Decision Records and ARCHITECTURE.md synthesis. Requires: sdlc-core

plugins.name: sdlc-event-modeling
plugins.description: Event Modeling (Adam Dymitruk) for event-sourced systems. Based on Martin Dilger's book. Requires: sdlc-core

plugins.name: sdlc-planning
plugins.description: Story planning with three-perspective review (business, technical, UX). Requires: sdlc-core

plugins.name: sdlc-tdd
plugins.description: Test-Driven Development workflow with Red/Green/Refactor cycle and domain modeling. Requires: sdlc-core

plugins.name: github-issues
plugins.description: Comprehensive GitHub issue management with sub-issues, blocking relationships, and linked branches

plugins.name: github-projects
plugins.description: GitHub Projects V2 Kanban board management with status/priority workflows. Requires: github-issues

plugins.name: marvin-sdlc
plugins.description: DEPRECATED - Use sdlc-core + sdlc-* plugins instead. Legacy monolithic SDLC plugin.
